```{r include=FALSE}
# --- Helper Functions ---

# Function to safely ensure ASReml model convergence
mkConv <- function(mod) {
  pctchg <- summary(mod)$varcomp[, c('%ch')]
  tries <- 1
  while(any(pctchg > 1, na.rm = TRUE) & tries < 20) {
    tries <- tries + 1
    mod <- suppressWarnings(update(mod))
    pctchg <- summary(mod)$varcomp[, c('%ch')]
  }
  return(mod)
}

# Function to fit and compare spatial models
fit_asreml_comparison <- function(fixed_f, random_f, residual_f, model_name, df) {
  tryCatch({
    m <- asreml(
      fixed = fixed_f, 
      random = random_f, 
      residual = residual_f, 
      data = df, 
      trace = FALSE, 
      maxiter = 50, 
      na.action = na.method(y = "include", x = "include")
    )
    if (!m$converge) m <- mkConv(m) # Using your custom convergence function
    
    aic_val  <- summary(m)$aic
    data.frame(
      Model = model_name, 
      AIC = aic_val, 
      LogLik = m$loglik, 
      Converged = m$converge, 
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    data.frame(Model = model_name, AIC = Inf, LogLik = NA, Converged = FALSE)
  })
}

# Function to run the final best model and extract metrics
# Function to run the final best model and extract metrics
run_final_analysis <- function(params, model_name, df, trial_name) {
  m_final <- asreml(
    fixed = params$f, 
    random = params$r, 
    residual = params$res, 
    data = df, 
    trace = FALSE, 
    maxiter = 50, 
    na.action = na.method(y = "include", x = "include")
  )
  if (!m_final$converge) m_final <- mkConv(m_final)
  
  vars <- m_final$sigma2 * m_final$vparameters
  
  # Extract Genetic Variance from the gkeep term
  Vg <- vars[grep("vm\\(gkeep", names(vars))]
  if (length(Vg) == 0) Vg <- NA 
  
  # Extract Error and Spatial Variances
  Ve <- vars[grep("colNumber:rowNumber!R", names(vars))]
  Vr <- if (grepl("AxAe", model_name)) vars[grep("units", names(vars))] else 0
  
  Vtotal <- Ve + Vr
  h2 <- if(!is.na(Vg)) Vg / (Vg + Vtotal/2) else NA
  
  tryCatch({
    # NEW: Dynamically extract fixed terms to ignore in predict
    fixed_terms <- attr(terms(params$f), "term.labels")
    # Identify any terms containing "lin(" or "spl("
    terms_to_ignore <- fixed_terms[grepl("lin\\(|spl\\(", fixed_terms)]
    
    # Predict using the gkeep column, passing ignored terms if they exist
    if (length(terms_to_ignore) > 0) {
      pred <- predict(m_final, classify = "gkeep", only = "vm(gkeep, G.inv)", 
                      ignore = terms_to_ignore, vcov = TRUE, sed = TRUE)
    } else {
      pred <- predict(m_final, classify = "gkeep", only = "vm(gkeep, G.inv)", 
                      vcov = TRUE, sed = TRUE)
    }
    
    mean_pev <- mean(diag(pred$vcov))
    avsed <- pred$avsed[2]^2 / 2
    GH_c <- if(!is.na(Vg)) (1 - avsed / Vg) else NA
    Acc <- if(!is.na(GH_c) && GH_c > 0) sqrt(GH_c) else NA
  }, error = function(e) {
    mean_pev <<- NA; avsed <<- NA; GH_c <<- NA; Acc <<- NA
  })
  
  return(data.frame(
    Trial = trial_name, Model = model_name, rG = NA, rE = NA, rR = NA, 
    Vg = Vg, Ve = Ve, Vr = Vr, h2 = h2, PEV = mean_pev, SED = avsed, 
    GH_c = GH_c, Acc = Acc, LogLik = m_final$loglik, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}


#' Extract Standardized Residuals and Identify Outliers
#'
#' This function updates a fitted asreml model to calculate the Average Outlier 
#' Measure (AOM), extracts the standardized conditional residuals, and filters 
#' for potential outliers based on a defined threshold.
#'
#' @param best_model A converged asreml model object
#' @param trial_data The original dataframe used for the trial
#' @param threshold Numeric value defining the outlier cutoff (default is 4)
#' @return A dataframe containing only the flagged outliers
extract_asreml_outliers <- function(best_model, trial_data, threshold = 4) {
  
  # 1. Update the model to compute outlier statistics
  # suppressWarnings is used to keep the console clean from minor update messages
  out.fm <- suppressWarnings(update.asreml(best_model, aom = TRUE))
  
  # 2. Initialize a new column for the residuals
  trial_data$scres <- NA
  
  # 3. Safely map residuals back to the dataframe
  # ASReml's working dataframe (out.fm$mf) only contains rows without missing target values.
  # We extract the row indices of the working data to place the residuals correctly.
  valid_rows <- as.numeric(rownames(out.fm$mf))
  
  # Extract the standardized conditional residuals (column 2 of the AOM R matrix)
  trial_data$scres[valid_rows] <- out.fm$aom$R[, 2]
  
  # 4. Filter the dataframe for true outliers using absolute value
  outliers <- trial_data[!is.na(trial_data$scres) & abs(trial_data$scres) > threshold, ]
  
  # 5. Keep only the most relevant columns to make the review easy
  outliers_clean <- subset(outliers, select = c(studyName, colNumber, rowNumber, 
                                                replicate, germplasmName, 
                                                grain_yield, scres))
  
  return(outliers_clean)
}
```

Get genotypes from _26 trials - prediction targets require GRM

## Get test candidates
```{r include=FALSE}
test_candidates <- read.csv("data/PredictionTarget.csv")

G.inv <- readRDS(here("Full26", "Ginv_full_26NOR.rds"))

# 1. Extract the genotyped IDs from the sparse matrix attributes
genotyped_ids <- attr(G.inv, "rowNames")

# 2. Define a helper function to evaluate matches for a single row
match_germplasm <- function(name, syn_string, valid_ids) {
  # Convert inputs to plain characters (since they are currently factors)
  name <- as.character(name)
  syn_string <- as.character(syn_string)
  
  # Check 1: Does the primary germplasmName exist in the genomic matrix?
  if (name %in% valid_ids) {
    return(name)
  }
  
  # Check 2: If no primary match, check the synonyms
  if (!is.na(syn_string) && syn_string != "") {
    # Split the string by comma and remove any accidental blank spaces
    syn_list <- str_trim(unlist(str_split(syn_string, ",")))
    
    # Identify which synonyms exist in the genomic data
    matched_syns <- syn_list[syn_list %in% valid_ids]
    
    # If at least one synonym matches, return the first valid one
    if (length(matched_syns) > 0) {
      return(matched_syns[1])
    }
  }
  
  # Return NA if absolutely nothing matches
  return(NA_character_)
}

# 3. Apply the matching logic to your phenotypic trial dataframe
YT.df <- YT.df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Create the gkeep column using our custom matching function
    gkeep = match_germplasm(germplasmName, germplasmSynonyms, genotyped_ids),
    
    # Create the gdrop column based on the result of gkeep
    gdrop = if_else(is.na(gkeep), as.character(germplasmName), NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() # Always ungroup after rowwise operations to maintain performance later
```

# Main Loop - Univariate
```{r}
# Setup directories for outputs
tables_dir <- "outputs/tables"
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# NEW: Create a dedicated directory for diagnostic plots
diagnostics_dir <- "outputs/diagnostics"
if (!dir.exists(diagnostics_dir)) dir.create(diagnostics_dir, recursive = TRUE)


# Get a list of unique trials
trial_list <- unique(as.character(YT.df$studyName))

for (trial_name_str in trial_list) {
  
  message("\n==================================================")
  message(paste("Processing Trial:", trial_name_str))
  message("==================================================")
  
  # Define expected output files
  selection_file <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(trial_name_str, "_Spatial_Model_Selection.csv"))
  metrics_file   <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(trial_name_str, "_Final_Metrics.csv"))
  plot_file_path <- file.path(diagnostics_dir, paste0(trial_name_str, "_Diagnostics.pdf"))
  
  # 1. FULL SKIP: If the diagnostics plot already exists, the trial is 100% complete
  if (file.exists(plot_file_path)) {
    message("  [✓] Trial fully processed (Models and Diagnostics complete). Skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    # --- Data Preparation ---
    trial_data <- YT.df %>% filter(studyName == trial_name_str)
    if(nrow(trial_data) == 0) stop("No data found for this trial.")
    
    analysis_data <- trial_data %>%
      mutate(Yield = as.numeric(scale(grain_yield))) %>% 
      mutate(across(c(rowNumber, colNumber, any_of("blockNumber")), as.factor)) %>%
      arrange(colNumber, rowNumber)
    
    analysis_data$gkeep <- factor(analysis_data$gkeep, levels = attr(G.inv, "rowNames"))
    analysis_data$gdrop <- as.factor(analysis_data$gdrop)
    
    # --- Build Random Terms ---
    has_blocks <- "blockNumber" %in% names(analysis_data) && n_distinct(analysis_data$blockNumber, na.rm = TRUE) > 1
    has_ungenotyped <- sum(!is.na(analysis_data$gdrop)) > 0
    
    rand_terms <- c("vm(gkeep, G.inv)", "colNumber", "rowNumber")
    if (has_ungenotyped) rand_terms <- c(rand_terms, "gdrop")
    if (has_blocks) rand_terms <- c(rand_terms, "blockNumber")
    
    base_rand_str <- paste("~", paste(rand_terms, collapse = " + "))
    
    # Define available models
    model_list <- list(
      "RCD"  = list(f = Yield ~ 1, r = as.formula(base_rand_str), res = ~ colNumber:rowNumber),
      "AxA"  = list(f = Yield ~ 1, r = as.formula(base_rand_str), res = ~ ar1(colNumber):ar1(rowNumber)),
      "AxAe" = list(f = Yield ~ 1, r = as.formula(paste(base_rand_str, "+ units")), res = ~ ar1(colNumber):ar1(rowNumber))
    )
    
    # 2. SMART BYPASS OR FULL RUN
    if (file.exists(selection_file) && file.exists(metrics_file)) {
      # BYPASS: Read the existing file to find the best model
      message("  [✓] Model selection files found. Loading best model...")
      saved_results <- read.csv(selection_file)
      best_model_name <- saved_results$Model[1] # Assumes CSV is sorted by AIC
      best_params <- model_list[[best_model_name]]
      
    } else {
      # FULL RUN: Fit all models, compare, and save
      message("  Fitting Univariate Spatial Models for comparison...")
      asreml_results <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_list, ~ fit_asreml_comparison(.x$f, .x$r, .x$res, .y, analysis_data)) %>% arrange(AIC)
      
      best_model_name <- asreml_results$Model[1]
      best_params <- model_list[[best_model_name]]
      
      univ_results <- run_final_analysis(best_params, paste0(best_model_name, "_Univ_Yield"), analysis_data, trial_name_str)
      all_model_results <- bind_rows(univ_results %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character)))
      
      write.csv(asreml_results, file = selection_file, row.names = FALSE)
      write.csv(all_model_results, file = metrics_file, row.names = FALSE)
      message(paste("  [✓] Model selection saved. Best Model:", best_model_name))
    }
    
    # 3. FIT THE BEST MODEL FOR DIAGNOSTICS
    message(paste("  Refitting best model (", best_model_name, ") for diagnostics..."))
    best_m_fit <- asreml(fixed = best_params$f, random = best_params$r, 
                         residual = best_params$res, data = analysis_data, 
                         trace = FALSE, maxiter = 50, 
                         na.action = na.method(y = "include", x = "include"))
    
    # Ensure it converged before extracting residuals
    if (!best_m_fit$converge) best_m_fit <- mkConv(best_m_fit)
    
    # --- Outlier Detection & Plotting ---
    message("  Extracting outliers and saving diagnostic plots...")
    
    trial_outliers <- extract_asreml_outliers(best_model = best_m_fit, 
                                              trial_data = analysis_data, 
                                              threshold = 4)
    
    if (nrow(trial_outliers) > 0) {
      write.csv(trial_outliers, 
                file = file.path(tables_dir, paste0(trial_name_str, "_Flagged_Outliers.csv")), 
                row.names = FALSE)
      message(paste("  [!] Found", nrow(trial_outliers), "outliers. Saved to review list."))
    } else {
      message("  [✓] No outliers > 4 detected.")
    }
    
    # Update model to generate Average Outlier Measure (AOM) for plotting
    out.fm <- suppressWarnings(update.asreml(best_m_fit, aom = TRUE))
    
    pdf(file = plot_file_path, width = 8, height = 6)
    
    tryCatch({
      plot(out.fm, res = 'stdCond', main = paste("Standardised Residuals:", trial_name_str))
    }, error = function(e) message("    [!] Could not plot residuals: ", e$message))
    
    tryCatch({
      met.asreml(best_m_fit) 
    }, error = function(e) message("    [!] Could not plot variogram: ", e$message))
    
    dev.off()
    message("  [✓] Diagnostic plots saved to folder.")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("  [!] Error processing trial:", e$message))
  })
}

```

# Diagnostic Review Template
```{r}
# --- Generate Diagnostic Review Template ---
require(writexl)
require(dplyr)
require(purrr)

message("\n==================================================")
message("Generating Trial Terms Template for Diagnostic Review")
message("==================================================")

tables_dir <- "outputs/tables"
selection_files <- list.files(tables_dir, pattern = "_Spatial_Model_Selection\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Pass YT.df into the function to check for blocks and ungenotyped lines
build_template_row <- function(file_path, full_data) {
  file_name <- basename(file_path)
  trial_name <- gsub("_Spatial_Model_Selection\\.csv$", "", file_name)
  
  model_data <- read.csv(file_path)
  best_model <- as.character(model_data$Model[1])
  
  # Filter data for this specific trial to check structure
  trial_data <- full_data %>% filter(studyName == trial_name)
  
  has_blocks <- "blockNumber" %in% names(trial_data) && n_distinct(trial_data$blockNumber, na.rm = TRUE) > 1
  has_ungenotyped <- sum(!is.na(trial_data$gdrop)) > 0
  
  # Rebuild the exact random terms used in the main loop
  rand_terms <- c("vm(gkeep, G.inv)", "colNumber", "rowNumber")
  if (has_ungenotyped) rand_terms <- c(rand_terms, "gdrop")
  if (has_blocks) rand_terms <- c(rand_terms, "blockNumber")
  if (!is.na(best_model) && best_model == "AxAe") rand_terms <- c(rand_terms, "units")
  
  base_fixed <- "Yield ~ 1"
  base_random <- paste("~", paste(rand_terms, collapse = " + "))
  
  data.frame(
    studyName = trial_name,
    best_model = best_model,
    fixed_terms = base_fixed,
    random_terms = base_random,
    remove_outliers = FALSE,  
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

if (length(selection_files) > 0) {
  # map_dfr allows us to pass YT.df as an extra argument to build_template_row
  template_df <- purrr::map_dfr(selection_files, ~build_template_row(.x, YT.df))
  
  template_path <- "outputs/Diagnostic_Review_Template.xlsx"
  write_xlsx(template_df, template_path)
  message(paste("  [✓] Excel template generated at:", template_path))
} else {
  message("  [!] No spatial model selection files found. Run the main loop first.")
}
```


# MODIFIED TRIAL
```{r}
# --- Evaluate Modified Models (MOD) ---
require(readxl)
require(dplyr)

message("\n==================================================")
message("Evaluating Human-Modified (MOD) Spatial Models")
message("==================================================")

tables_dir <- "outputs/tables"
template_path <- "outputs/Diagnostic_Review_Template.xlsx"

if (!file.exists(template_path)) {
  stop("Excel template not found. Please run the template generation chunk first.")
}

mod_data <- read_xlsx(template_path)

for (i in 1:nrow(mod_data)) {
  
  trial_name_str <- mod_data$studyName[i]
  base_model     <- mod_data$best_model[i]
  rem_outliers   <- as.logical(mod_data$remove_outliers[i]) # Check the flag
  
  message(paste("\nTesting MOD for Trial:", trial_name_str))
  
  trial_data <- YT.df %>% filter(studyName == trial_name_str)
  if(nrow(trial_data) == 0) next
  
  # --- NEW: Outlier Handling ---
  if (isTRUE(rem_outliers)) {
    outlier_file <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(trial_name_str, "_Flagged_Outliers.csv"))
    
    if (file.exists(outlier_file)) {
      outliers_df <- read.csv(outlier_file)
      message(paste("  [!] Removing", nrow(outliers_df), "flagged outliers..."))
      
      # Match by row and col, converting to character to ensure safe joins
      trial_data <- trial_data %>%
        mutate(col_match = as.character(colNumber), row_match = as.character(rowNumber)) %>%
        left_join(
          outliers_df %>% 
            mutate(col_match = as.character(colNumber), row_match = as.character(rowNumber)) %>%
            select(col_match, row_match, is_outlier = scres),
          by = c("col_match", "row_match")
        ) %>%
        # If the plot is flagged, set its yield to NA
        mutate(grain_yield = ifelse(!is.na(is_outlier), NA, grain_yield)) %>%
        select(-col_match, -row_match, -is_outlier)
      
    } else {
      message("  [!] remove_outliers is TRUE, but no Outlier CSV was found. Proceeding normally.")
    }
  }
  
  # Data prep continues (the scaled Yield will automatically inherit the NAs we just made)
  analysis_data <- trial_data %>%
    mutate(Yield = as.numeric(scale(grain_yield))) %>% 
    mutate(across(c(rowNumber, colNumber, any_of("blockNumber")), as.factor)) %>%
    arrange(colNumber, rowNumber)
  
  analysis_data$gkeep <- factor(analysis_data$gkeep, levels = attr(G.inv, "rowNames"))
  analysis_data$gdrop <- as.factor(analysis_data$gdrop)
  
  tryCatch({
    f_form <- as.formula(mod_data$fixed_terms[i])
    r_form <- as.formula(mod_data$random_terms[i])
    
    if (grepl("AxA", base_model)) {
      res_form <- ~ ar1(colNumber):ar1(rowNumber)
    } else {
      res_form <- ~ colNumber:rowNumber
    }
    
    m_mod <- asreml(
      fixed = f_form, 
      random = r_form, 
      residual = res_form, 
      data = analysis_data, 
      trace = FALSE, 
      maxiter = 50, 
      na.action = na.method(y = "include", x = "include")
    )
    if (!m_mod$converge) m_mod <- mkConv(m_mod)
    
    # Update Model Selection CSV
    sel_file <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(trial_name_str, "_Spatial_Model_Selection.csv"))
    if (file.exists(sel_file)) {
      sel_df <- read.csv(sel_file) %>% filter(Model != "MOD")
      
      mod_row <- data.frame(
        Model = "MOD", 
        AIC = summary(m_mod)$aic, 
        LogLik = m_mod$loglik, 
        Converged = m_mod$converge,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      sel_df <- bind_rows(sel_df, mod_row) %>% arrange(AIC)
      write.csv(sel_df, sel_file, row.names = FALSE)
      message(paste("  [✓] Updated AIC selection. MOD AIC:", round(mod_row$AIC, 2)))
    }
    
    # Update Final Metrics CSV
    met_file <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(trial_name_str, "_Final_Metrics.csv"))
    if (file.exists(met_file)) {
      
      # THE FIX: Read the CSV and cast all columns to character to match the incoming data
      met_df <- read.csv(met_file) %>% 
        mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>% 
        filter(!grepl("MOD", Model))
      
      mod_params <- list(f = f_form, r = r_form, res = res_form)
      mod_metrics <- run_final_analysis(mod_params, "MOD_Univ_Yield", analysis_data, trial_name_str)
      
      mod_metrics <- mod_metrics %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
      met_df <- bind_rows(met_df, mod_metrics)
      
      write.csv(met_df, met_file, row.names = FALSE)
      message("  [✓] Updated variance components and metrics.")
    }
    
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("  [!] Error evaluating MOD model:", e$message))
  })
}
```




# Final Model Summary
```{r}
# --- Generate Final Model Summary Report ---
require(readxl)
require(writexl)
require(dplyr)
require(purrr)

message("\n==================================================")
message("Generating Final Model Summary Report (with Formulas)")
message("==================================================")

tables_dir <- "outputs/tables"
template_path <- "outputs/Diagnostic_Review_Template.xlsx"

if (!file.exists(template_path)) {
  stop("Diagnostic template not found. Cannot determine MOD formulas or outlier status.")
}

# 1. Read the template to capture your manual formulas and outlier decisions
mod_data <- read_xlsx(template_path)

# 2. Find all the model selection files
selection_files <- list.files(tables_dir, pattern = "_Spatial_Model_Selection\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# 3. Helper function to extract the winning model and its specific terms
get_best_model_info <- function(file_path, full_data, template_df) {
  trial_name <- gsub("_Spatial_Model_Selection\\.csv$", "", basename(file_path))
  
  # Get winning model from the CSV
  model_data <- read.csv(file_path)
  best_row <- model_data[1, ]
  final_mod_name <- best_row$Model
  
  # Get the template data for this specific trial
  trial_template <- template_df %>% filter(studyName == trial_name)
  base_model_from_template <- trial_template$best_model[1]
  
  # Extract outlier decision
  outliers_rem <- if(nrow(trial_template) > 0 && !is.na(trial_template$remove_outliers[1])) {
    as.logical(trial_template$remove_outliers[1])
  } else {
    FALSE
  }
  
  # Determine the exact formulas used
  if (final_mod_name == "MOD") {
    # If MOD won, pull the exact terms the user typed in the template
    f_term <- trial_template$fixed_terms[1]
    r_term <- trial_template$random_terms[1]
    
    # Residuals for MOD were based on the original base model
    res_term <- ifelse(grepl("AxA", base_model_from_template), 
                       "~ ar1(colNumber):ar1(rowNumber)", 
                       "~ colNumber:rowNumber")
  } else {
    # If a base model won, reconstruct its exact base formulas
    trial_data <- full_data %>% filter(studyName == trial_name)
    has_blocks <- "blockNumber" %in% names(trial_data) && n_distinct(trial_data$blockNumber, na.rm = TRUE) > 1
    has_ungenotyped <- sum(!is.na(trial_data$gdrop)) > 0
    
    f_term <- "Yield ~ 1"
    
    rand_list <- c("vm(gkeep, G.inv)", "colNumber", "rowNumber")
    if (has_ungenotyped) rand_list <- c(rand_list, "gdrop")
    if (has_blocks) rand_list <- c(rand_list, "blockNumber")
    if (final_mod_name == "AxAe") rand_list <- c(rand_list, "units")
    
    r_term <- paste("~", paste(rand_list, collapse = " + "))
    
    res_term <- ifelse(grepl("AxA", final_mod_name), 
                       "~ ar1(colNumber):ar1(rowNumber)", 
                       "~ colNumber:rowNumber")
  }
  
  data.frame(
    studyName = trial_name,
    final_model = final_mod_name,
    outliers_removed = outliers_rem,
    fixed_terms = f_term,
    random_terms = r_term,
    residual_terms = res_term,
    AIC = best_row$AIC,
    Converged = best_row$Converged,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

if (length(selection_files) > 0) {
  # 4. Extract best models across all trials, passing the dataframe and template along
  final_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(selection_files, ~get_best_model_info(.x, YT.df, mod_data)) %>%
    arrange(studyName)
  
  # 5. Write the final comprehensive report
  output_path <- "outputs/Final_Model_Summary.xlsx"
  write_xlsx(final_summary, output_path)
  
  message(paste("  [✓] Final summary report generated at:", output_path))
  
} else {
  message("  [!] No spatial model selection files found.")
}

```
# MET
```{r}
# --- Phase 1: Data Harmonization & Pre-Processing ---
require(asreml)
require(dplyr)
require(readxl)
require(stringr)

message("\n==================================================")
message("Constructing 1-Stage MET Model (Step-Up Phase 1)")
message("==================================================")

tables_dir <- "outputs/tables"
final_summary_path <- "outputs/Final_Model_Summary.xlsx"

if (!file.exists(final_summary_path)) {
  stop("Final_Model_Summary.xlsx not found. Please ensure the univariate pipeline is complete.")
}

final_summary <- read_xlsx(final_summary_path)

# 1. Aggregate and Pre-process
# Group by trial to scale yield (if scaling was preferred) or use raw yield. 
# Here we calculate Yield as raw grain_yield to let diag() model the heterogeneous variances.
met_data <- YT.df %>%
  filter(studyName %in% final_summary$studyName) %>%
  mutate(
    Yield = grain_yield, # Using raw trait values for MET
    rowNum_num = as.numeric(as.character(rowNumber)),
    colNum_num = as.numeric(as.character(colNumber))
  )

# 2. Execute Outlier Masking Programmatically
for (i in 1:nrow(final_summary)) {
  t_name <- final_summary$studyName[i]
  rem_outliers <- as.logical(final_summary$outliers_removed[i])
  
  if (isTRUE(rem_outliers)) {
    outlier_file <- file.path(tables_dir, paste0(t_name, "_Flagged_Outliers.csv"))
    if (file.exists(outlier_file)) {
      outliers <- read.csv(outlier_file)
      message(paste("  [-] Masking", nrow(outliers), "outliers for trial:", t_name))
      
      # Match by plot and set Yield to NA (preserving the spatial grid)
      met_data <- met_data %>%
        mutate(
          Yield = case_when(
            studyName == t_name & paste(colNumber, rowNumber, sep="_") %in% 
              paste(outliers$colNumber, outliers$rowNumber, sep="_") ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ Yield
          )
        )
    }
  }
}

# 3. Enforce Strict Factorization and Initialize 'units'
met_data <- met_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Explicitly create the units term (1 to N)
    units = as.factor(row_number()), 
    # Use any_of() so it safely ignores columns that might not exist
    across(any_of(c("studyName", "blockNumber", "rowNumber", "colNumber")), as.factor)
  )

# Phase 2 (G-matrix) is handled via your existing G.inv object
met_data$gkeep <- factor(met_data$gkeep, levels = attr(G.inv, "rowNames"))
met_data$gdrop <- as.factor(met_data$gdrop)

# --- Phase 3: Model Specification and Initialization ---
message("  Building dynamic MET equations...")

# 1. Formulate Fixed Equation
fixed_str <- "Yield ~ studyName"

# Dynamically add linear trends if they were identified in the univariate stage
trials_lin_row <- final_summary$studyName[grepl("lin\\(rowNumber\\)", final_summary$fixed_terms)]
trials_lin_col <- final_summary$studyName[grepl("lin\\(colNumber\\)", final_summary$fixed_terms)]

for (t in trials_lin_row) fixed_str <- paste0(fixed_str, " + at(studyName, '", t, "'):rowNum_num")
for (t in trials_lin_col) fixed_str <- paste0(fixed_str, " + at(studyName, '", t, "'):colNum_num")

fixed_eq <- as.formula(fixed_str)

# 2. Formulate Random Equation (Base Step-Up Model: DIAG)
random_str <- "~ diag(studyName):vm(gkeep, G.inv) + diag(studyName):gdrop"

# Dynamically map the trial-specific spatial/design elements
for (i in 1:nrow(final_summary)) {
  t <- final_summary$studyName[i]
  r_term <- final_summary$random_terms[i]
  
  if (grepl("blockNumber", r_term)) random_str <- paste0(random_str, " + at(studyName, '", t, "'):blockNumber")
  if (grepl("colNumber", r_term))   random_str <- paste0(random_str, " + at(studyName, '", t, "'):colNumber")
  if (grepl("rowNumber", r_term))   random_str <- paste0(random_str, " + at(studyName, '", t, "'):rowNumber")
  if (grepl("units", r_term))       random_str <- paste0(random_str, " + at(studyName, '", t, "'):units")
}

random_eq <- as.formula(random_str)

# 3. Formulate Residual Equation
# Using the dsum syntax for heterogeneous AR1 x AR1 errors across trials
residual_eq <- ~ dsum(~ ar1(colNumber):ar1(rowNumber) | studyName)


# --- Phase 4: Model Execution and Step-Up Strategy ---
message("\n  Executing Base MET Model (diag GxE)...")
message(paste("  Fixed Eq:", fixed_str))

# Ensure data is sorted for AR1
met_data <- met_data %>% arrange(studyName, colNumber, rowNumber)

tryCatch({
  # Fit the base independent GxE model
  met_step1 <- asreml(
    fixed = fixed_eq, 
    random = random_eq, 
    residual = residual_eq, 
    data = met_data,
    workspace = "46gb", 
    pworkspace = "32gb",
    trace = TRUE, 
    maxiter = 50, 
    na.action = na.method(y = "include", x = "include")
  )
  
  # Ensure convergence
  if (!met_step1$converge) {
    message("  [!] Initial MET model did not converge. Attempting mkConv update...")
    met_step1 <- mkConv(met_step1)
  }
  
  message("  [✓] MET Step 1 Model (DIAG) converged successfully.")
  
  # Save the base model workspace object so you don't have to refit it later
  saveRDS(met_step1, "outputs/MET_Step1_Diag_Model.rds")
  
}, error = function(e) {
  message("  [!] Error executing MET model: ", e$message)
})
```
